label: Row
purpose: Generic row block used in multiple sections with different field requirements
_notes:
IMPORTANT: The 'row' block has DIFFERENT relevant settings depending on the section. For 'results' section: use only percentage (number), row_heading (text), row_text (richtext - MUST wrap with

tags). For 'comparison-table' section: use only benefit (inline_richtext), us, others, others_2, others_3 (all checkboxes). Check which section you're adding blocks to, and only set the keys relevant to that section on each block instance!
